title: New Lottery Company Ltd v The Gambling Commission
description: The New Lottery Company Ltd (TNLC) challenged the award of the Fourth National Lottery Licence to Allwyn Entertainment Ltd, alleging wrongful award and post-award modifications. The judge dismissed TNLC's claims in full, finding they were properly disqualified for failing over half of mandatory requirements and had a significant score gap with Allwyn. The damages claim was also dismissed due to lack of standing.
